title: Fungal Characters: data release
description:
A free, publicly maintained list of the characters (observable features) used to describe and identify fungi: names, scientific names, definitions, value types and value options, each with a permanent code (FCC##### for characters, FCV##### for value options). Translations included where volunteers have written them.

Files: Excel, CSV, JSON, SQL for PostgreSQL 16/17 and MySQL 8, SKOS (Turtle) and SDD 1.1 (XML), in data/releases/<version>/. Current data and the read-only API: https://fungalcharacters.org/.

License: the character data is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0; the website code in this archive is MIT-licensed. Please cite as: Fungal Characters, release <version>, https://fungalcharacters.org/
